headline: Jets' Juniors Drop a Deuce — Literally, 199 Points of Pure Domination
subhead: Week 4 was a bloodbath: three matchups decided by 50+ points, and 226 Alpha left an entire fantasy team on the bench.
matchOfTheWeek: LargestofRocks vs. Bo Nix Celli was the only matchup with a pulse, with Rocks squeaking by 7.78 thanks to Jayden Reed (27.1) and Jayden Daniels (25.0). Celli posted a league-best 97.8% lineup efficiency and STILL lost — then immediately panic-traded Chris Godwin and Chuba Hubbard for Khalil Herbert and Jonathan Mingo. Read that sentence again. He's going to read it every night before bed for the rest of the season.
powerRankingsShakeup: Jets' Juniors and Put an AR to My Head are throwing 175+ point haymakers and look like the class of the league, while T swift's Baddies and 226 Alpha are speedrunning the lottery odds.
mainRecap:
Let's start with the obvious: Jets' Juniors hung 199.60 on Hot Cocks like it was a Madden game on rookie mode. Derrick Henry (35.9), Nico Collins (33.1), and Jordan Love (31.16) all went nuclear, and Wunder still left 22.2 Josh Downs points on the bench just to flex. Hot Cocks scored 147 — a winning total in any other week — and got curb-stomped by 52. Baker Mayfield's 28.88 and Tucker Kraft's 20.3 bench points are now just footnotes in someone else's highlight reel.

Meanwhile, Put an AR to My Head dumped 178 on MassiveCocks, who managed a sad 118 and watched Justice Hill rot on the bench for 21.6. That's two MassiveCocks blowouts deep into the season — at this rate the team name is starting to feel aspirational.

The Olave Garden put 159 on T swift's Baddies behind Justin Fields (31.98) and Alvin Kamara (24.9). Tnicolle's Baddies have officially entered their Eras Tour: the Getting Smoked Era. 51-point loss, no notes.

Now for the week's true crime: 226 Alpha. Szara scored 107.98 — last in the league — while leaving 53.34 points on the bench, including a 29.5-point D'Andre Swift detonation. The optimal lineup was 161.32. He would've beaten four teams. Instead he beat zero. That's not a lineup mistake, that's a felony.

OnlyFants quietly handled The Good Ladds 133-118 thanks to a 33.6 from Kenneth Walker, and Stroud Boys put 137 on 226 Alpha's wounded corpse. Mig56 had no answer, Bjewett didn't need one.

Four teams broke 145. Two teams couldn't break 110. The middle class is dead in Delt Dynasty.
